statusDetail: Coverage-complete agentic audit of five representative public templates plus a 404 recovery state.

page.notes: Localized adult media catalogue; dark visual theme, SSR, PWA manifest/service worker, consent and age-verification surfaces.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The rendered surface is dark and remains coherent under emulated dark preference; CSS contains both light and dark media branches.
Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, eight 2-second continuously running animations remained active and no reduced-motion media rule was found.
Forced-colors and increased-contrast capture retained readable text, visible controls, and clear boundaries.

checkOutcomes.method: Route screenshots plus CSS feature probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: No view-transition CSS/API signal was present; navigation between homepage, category, search and detail surfaces is an abrupt document swap.
No scroll-linked parallax, scrollytelling, or reveal interaction was observed on the representative surfaces.
checkOutcomes.reason: The audited templates do not use scroll-linked motion, so there is no implementation to assess.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The audited homepage, listing, search, signup and detail paths expose conventional links and controls rather than a gesture-dependent flow.
checkOutcomes.reason: No representative gesture-driven interaction was present in the audited paths.

checkOutcomes.method: Long-page screenshot and CSS feature inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: Long listing pages retain static navigation chrome; no scroll-state query, progress indicator, or shrinking-header signal was found.
The site exposes dropdown/menu UI but no anchor-name or position-anchor CSS signal was found, so edge-aware anchoring is not implemented declaratively.
Route changes and in-page navigation provide no transition or highlight cue showing where attention moved.
A large cookie dialog covers most of the first desktop viewport and obscures the primary content before interaction.
The signup consent surface is a custom DIV with role=dialog rather than a native dialog/popover primitive; dismissal is manually wired.
After consent, content cards occupy the main reading area and persistent chrome is limited to header, navigation and a sidebar appropriate to a catalogue.
At a 360x800 viewport the layout reports 1024px content width and 664px horizontal overflow, with desktop sidebar/navigation consuming most of the screen.

checkOutcomes.method: CSS feature probe and mobile screenshot
checkOutcomes.evidence: No container-query signal was found and catalogue components retain desktop-sized structure in the narrow capture.

checkOutcomes.method: Focus probe plus Lighthouse accessibility audit
checkOutcomes.evidence: Focused search controls compute to outline:none/0 and Lighthouse found insufficient target size/spacing.
The homepage has a clear H1, prominent search field, catalogue cards and primary navigation that communicate the service and next actions.
Search produced a populated result page, a catalogue card led to a detail page, and signup exposed social and email options.
Invalid signup submission produced specific Korean required/password messages, and an unknown URL returned a branded 404 with recovery navigation.
Mobile Lighthouse measured LCP 3.1s, outside the good <=2.5s range; desktop trace LCP was 1.26s, showing a mobile-specific gap.
The mobile layout observer recorded CLS 0 with no shift entries during the capture window.
The trace found two long tasks, 159ms total blocking time and a 167ms longest task; this is bounded and Lighthouse still scored performance 0.91.
The load made 141 requests; Lighthouse estimated 118KiB cache-lifetime savings and the HAR found three parser-blocking stylesheets plus uncompressed SVG assets.
Lighthouse estimated 56KiB unused CSS, 26KiB unused JS and 11KiB legacy JavaScript.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse accessibility audit and signup DOM probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse found an unnamed button, role misuse on a list item, label/name mismatches, and malformed list semantics; the expanded email field also lacked a label/ARIA name.
Lighthouse measured key age-verification text at 2.15:1 and 1.75:1 against green, below the 4.5:1 requirement, plus low-contrast metadata and indistinct links.

checkOutcomes.method: Keyboard focus probe and Lighthouse structure audits
checkOutcomes.evidence: Search controls show no computed focus outline; Lighthouse also found invalid list structure and an inappropriate button role.
Body and heading text in desktop, mobile and forced-colors captures is generally readable, consistently aligned, and not clipped vertically.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse viewport/target audits and detail probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse found user-scalable=no, undersized/overlapping touch targets, and the video detail exposed no caption track in the inspected player markup.
Lighthouse best-practices scored 1.0 and reported no console-error or uncaught-exception failure.
The document has a valid doctype and UTF-8 charset, but image inspection found 29 images missing dimensions and 12 oversized images; Lighthouse independently flagged unsized images.
Lighthouse best-practices scored 1.0; no load-time permission prompt or paste-prevention behavior was observed.
Homepage, search and video detail each expose descriptive localized titles and meta descriptions.
Links use real href values, viewport metadata is present, robots permits public surfaces, and Lighthouse SEO scored 1.0.
Canonical URLs point to the different ko.xhamster2.com host, no hreflang links are exposed despite many localized hosts, and /sitemap.xml returned 404.
No Open Graph tags or JSON-LD were present on the homepage, and the representative video detail exposed no VideoObject JSON-LD.
HTTPS and HSTS are present, but CSP only declares frame-ancestors, nosniff and Referrer-Policy are missing, and two first-party cookies lack Secure while two use SameSite=None.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR, tracker and initial-load consent evidence
checkOutcomes.evidence: Before consent, 116 of 141 requests and 1.70MB of 1.89MB were classified third-party; an ad request included a persistent stats UID and page keywords in its query.
No permission prompt fired on load, but the account/signup surface offered password and social sign-in with no passkey/WebAuthn option or signal.
Clickjacking protection and HSTS exist, but the CSP provides no script/style policy, Referrer-Policy and nosniff are missing, and Permissions-Policy is narrowly configured.
Raw HTML returned 200 with 80% rendered-content coverage and retained title, H1 and description; the page is not a JS shell.
At narrow width, overlays/navigation remain tied to a 1024px desktop layout and are cut off rather than repositioning within the 360px viewport.
A manifest with start_url/icons/display exists and an active service worker contains fetch, cache and offline/fallback handling.
A representative unknown route returned an intentional HTTP 404 with a localized branded error view and navigation, rather than a blank shell.
The root lang=ko is correct, but no hreflang links are exposed and stylesheet inspection counted 599 physical left/right declarations, reducing writing-mode resilience.
The audited surfaces show catalogue durations/count labels but no currency, calendar date, address or user-entered locale-sensitive value whose formatting could be exercised.
checkOutcomes.reason: No locale-sensitive data flow was present in the selected public paths.

checkOutcomes.evidence: No scheduled event, timestamp entry or cross-zone recurring-time flow appeared in the representative paths.
checkOutcomes.reason: The audited public surfaces do not expose a time-zone-sensitive task.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Consent offers equally prominent approve/reject actions and signup disclosure states data use and links terms/privacy; third-party content is labelled in the accessibility tree.
Submitting incomplete signup data produced specific Korean required-field and minimum-password messages rather than a generic failure.
The email signup field uses autocomplete=off instead of email, while the password correctly uses new-password; this obstructs autofill for a primary account flow.
Signup explains terms and data use, but the relevant account flow offers no phishing-resistant passkey option and relies on passwords/social identity.

checkOutcomes.method: Images primitive and Lighthouse image diagnostics
checkOutcomes.evidence: Image inspection found 12 oversized images, 16 legacy-format assets, 29 without dimensions and eight below-fold images not lazy-loaded; Lighthouse estimated 54KiB image savings.
The initial load ships 62 script requests and Lighthouse identifies unused CSS/JS plus legacy code, indicating avoidable transfer and parse work.
Third parties account for 116 requests and 1.70MB of 1.89MB transferred, including Google identity and ad/media origins before a consent choice.
The public catalogue is crawlable server-rendered content, but recon found no declared agent-facing transaction or productivity capability requiring WebMCP tools.
checkOutcomes.reason: No agent-facing capability is declared or necessary for the representative public browsing paths; this emerging check is contextual.

checkOutcomes.evidence: No summarization, generation, translation-assistance or other inference task is exposed by the audited pages.
checkOutcomes.reason: There is no user task in the selected paths that would benefit from site-provided on-device inference.

checkOutcomes.method: Repeated interaction metrics and paired heap summaries
checkOutcomes.evidence: After ten language-menu open/close cycles, DOM nodes and animation count stayed exactly 1794 and 8; JS heap increased only ~314KB. Independent heap summaries differed by ~0.9%, not an unbounded signal.
The loaded catalogue retained about 36MB self-size for 1,794 rendered DOM nodes, proportionate to a media catalogue with 141 network resources.

checkOutcomes.method: Paired heap summaries and repeated metrics
checkOutcomes.evidence: Repeated interaction did not increase DOM node count or animation count, and no Detached* constructor appeared among the largest heap constructors.

principleOutcomes.reason: No agent-facing capability is declared or necessary for the representative public browsing paths; this emerging check is contextual. There is no user task in the selected paths that would benefit from site-provided on-device inference.

paths.description: Homepage/catalogue entry, global navigation, consent, preferences, performance, security and responsive behavior.
Primary search-results journey and filter/listing archetype.
Representative media detail/playback archetype and rich-metadata/media-alternative review.
Primary account/signup flow including expanded email fields and invalid submission.

findings.summary: Continuous animation ignores reduced-motion preference
findings.evidence: Eight 2-second looping animations remained active under reduce, with no matching CSS media rule.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a prefers-reduced-motion: reduce branch that removes nonessential iterations/transitions and pauses auto-advance.

findings.summary: Navigation changes are abrupt
findings.evidence: No view-transition signal was found across homepage, category and search changes.
findings.suggestedFix: Add progressive same/cross-document View Transitions for route and filter-state changes, with reduced-motion handling.

findings.summary: Long pages provide no scroll-state guidance
findings.evidence: The long catalogue keeps static chrome and exposes no progress/shrinking header behavior.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a compact sticky header and scroll-state/progress affordance that preserves content space.

findings.summary: Dropdown positioning is not declaratively anchored
findings.evidence: Menu UI exists but no anchor-name/position-anchor/position-try CSS was found.
findings.suggestedFix: Adopt CSS anchor positioning and position-try fallbacks for dropdowns/tooltips near viewport edges.

findings.summary: Cookie consent obscures the first viewport
findings.evidence: The initial desktop screenshot shows consent covering most content.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a compact, non-obscuring consent surface where legally possible, preserve equally clear reject/accept actions, and avoid blocking content reading.

findings.summary: Consent/signup overlay uses a custom dialog DIV
findings.evidence: DOM inspection found DIV role=dialog rather than native dialog/popover.
findings.suggestedFix: Move modal flows to <dialog> with showModal/close and transient UI to popover, retaining accessible labels and focus restoration.

findings.summary: Mobile layout is a 1024px desktop canvas
findings.evidence: At 360px, measured horizontal overflow is 664px and the sidebar crowds out primary content.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove fixed desktop widths, use intrinsic/fluid tracks and collapse navigation so scrollWidth equals the visual viewport.

findings.summary: Reusable catalogue components do not adapt at component level
findings.evidence: No container queries were found and narrow cards retain desktop structure.
findings.suggestedFix: Define container-type on catalogue regions and use @container breakpoints for card/nav composition.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus and touch targeting are inadequate
findings.evidence: Focused search controls computed no outline; Lighthouse found undersized/overlapping targets.
findings.suggestedFix: Add strong :focus-visible indicators and ensure all targets have at least 24x24 CSS px safe space, preferably 44x44 for primary controls.

findings.summary: Mobile LCP misses the good threshold
findings.evidence: Lighthouse mobile LCP was 3.1s versus the <=2.5s good range.
findings.suggestedFix: Profile the mobile LCP candidate, prioritize its resource, and defer lower-value scripts/styles until after critical content.

findings.summary: Resource delivery has avoidable cache and critical-path cost
findings.evidence: 141 requests, 118KiB cache savings, three parser-blocking stylesheets and uncompressed SVGs were observed.
findings.suggestedFix: Extend immutable caching for versioned assets, compress SVG, inline only critical CSS and defer remaining styles.

findings.summary: Unused and legacy code ships on first load
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 56KiB unused CSS, 26KiB unused JS and 11KiB legacy JS.
findings.suggestedFix: Split page bundles by feature, conditionally import optional modules and remove legacy transforms for Baseline targets.

findings.summary: Controls and lists have accessibility-tree defects
findings.evidence: Unnamed button, role misuse, name mismatch, malformed lists and an unlabeled email input were observed.
findings.suggestedFix: Give every control a stable accessible name, restore valid list children/roles, and associate explicit labels with signup inputs.

findings.summary: Important text fails contrast minimums
findings.evidence: Age-verification text measured 2.15:1 and 1.75:1; metadata and links also fail.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust foreground/background tokens to at least 4.5:1 for normal text and distinguish inline links beyond color.

findings.summary: Focus is invisible and semantic structure is invalid
findings.evidence: Search controls have no focus outline; list children and a list-item button role are invalid.
findings.suggestedFix: Implement :focus-visible across controls and replace clickable list-item role hacks with valid links/buttons in valid list markup.

findings.summary: Zoom, touch targeting and media alternatives are incomplete
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found user-scalable=no and target-size failures; no caption track appeared on the detail path.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove user-scalable=no, fix reflow/targets, and provide captions or equivalent text tracks for spoken media.

findings.summary: Many images lack dimensions or are oversized
findings.evidence: 29 images lack dimensions and 12 exceed 2x display width; Lighthouse flags unsized images.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit width/height or aspect-ratio and right-sized srcset/sizes candidates for every thumbnail.

findings.summary: Localized indexing signals are inconsistent
findings.evidence: Canonical targets a different host, hreflang is absent, and sitemap.xml is 404.
findings.suggestedFix: Choose a stable canonical host, add reciprocal hreflang for localized equivalents, and publish/reference a valid sitemap.

findings.summary: Video/content pages lack rich and share metadata
findings.evidence: No Open Graph or JSON-LD was found; detail page lacks VideoObject data.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate OG/Twitter metadata and schema.org VideoObject JSON-LD matching visible title, thumbnail, duration and availability.

findings.summary: Security policy and cookie hardening are incomplete
findings.evidence: CSP only sets frame-ancestors; nosniff/Referrer-Policy are missing; two cookies lack Secure.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a nonce/hash-based CSP, nosniff and strict-origin-when-cross-origin, then mark every HTTPS cookie Secure with least-permissive SameSite.

findings.summary: Third-party data flows start before consent
findings.evidence: 116 third-party requests transfer 1.70MB before choice; an ad URL carries stats UID and page keywords.
findings.suggestedFix: Gate nonessential identity/ad/analytics requests on consent, minimize query identifiers and batch first-party measurement.

findings.summary: Account flow lacks a phishing-resistant sign-in option
findings.evidence: Signup offers password and federated identity but no passkey/WebAuthn option.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer passkey registration/authentication alongside existing methods and use passkeys for sensitive reauthentication.

findings.summary: Top-layer/navigation UI is cut off on narrow screens
findings.evidence: A 360px viewport renders a 1024px layout with content and controls outside view.
findings.suggestedFix: Make top-layer and navigation components viewport-constrained with intrinsic sizing and responsive fallback placement.

findings.summary: Localized layout is not writing-mode resilient
findings.evidence: No hreflang links and 599 physical left/right CSS declarations were detected.
findings.suggestedFix: Add reciprocal locale links and migrate component layout to inline/block logical properties, testing RTL locales.

findings.summary: Email signup disables autofill
findings.evidence: The visible email field reports autocomplete=off while password uses new-password.
findings.suggestedFix: Use type=email and autocomplete=email (or username as appropriate), with explicit labels and stable names.

findings.summary: Thumbnail delivery wastes bytes
findings.evidence: 12 oversized, 16 legacy-format and eight non-lazy below-fold images were found; Lighthouse estimates 54KiB savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate appropriately compressed AVIF/WebP candidates, correct sizes, dimensions and below-fold lazy loading.

findings.summary: Initial bundles include avoidable work
findings.evidence: 62 scripts load initially while code diagnostics identify unused and legacy portions.
findings.suggestedFix: Conditionally import optional features, remove legacy output and delay nonessential work until interaction/idle.

findings.summary: Third-party cost dominates the page budget
findings.evidence: Third parties account for 116/141 requests and 1.70MB/1.89MB transferred.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a third-party budget, gate nonessential vendors, self-host stable dependencies where justified and defer media/ad fetches.

taskList.title: Rebuild narrow-screen reflow and top-layer constraints
Fix accessible names, semantics, contrast, focus, zoom and target sizing
Gate and minimize third-party requests before consent
Harden CSP, response headers and cookie flags
Optimize critical delivery, bundles and media assets
Correct canonical, hreflang, sitemap and rich metadata
Improve signup autofill and add passkeys
Adopt native/anchored navigation and overlay primitives
Migrate localized layout to logical properties
